title: Shoes
sub: Five shoe brands with real markdowns of 40 to 60 percent right now.

brands.say: Hero is the Sally woven leather flat in chocolate, was $498, now $249, 12 of 13 sizes left. The Ria boat shoe is $159 from $398. Minnie ballet sneaker is half off at $175 in every size. Final sale, no returns.
brands.why_not: Homepage only advertises 25% off; these deeper cuts are sale-section styles in spring colors. Sheet lists code VIPFRIDAY26 but it is not on the homepage, so not used.

brands.say: Hero is the Isabel pointed kitten heel in black calfskin, was $665, now $399. Delicat strappy heel in bordeaux is $387 from $645, 12 of 13 sizes. Salomé suede mary jane is $366 from $610.
